paper_id: Breaking the Hourglass Phenomenon of Residual Quantization_ Enhancing the Upper Bound of Generative Retrieval__oa_W4401306654
title: Breaking the Hourglass Phenomenon of Residual Quantization: Enhancing the Upper Bound of Generative Retrieval
motivation: 工业场景中RQ-SID的中间层token过度集中,导致表示能力受限
problem_framing: 将Hourglass现象形式化为路径稀疏和长尾分布问题
key_insight: 残差量化固有特性导致层级间非均匀→均匀交替分布,是Hourglass的本质成因
method_signature: 启发式删除第二层 + 自适应变长token移除策略(top@K)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 方法简单高效但非最优,只能缓解而非彻底解决Hourglass现象
evidence_for_taste: can only alleviate, but not completely resolve
thinking_moves: 从工程现象(hourglass)反推底层量化机制失效
将长尾分布问题归因于残差的固有属性
提出简单启发式解法而非复杂重构
